scope: Thirteen explicit one-character codebooks, whole DBBI/FAED in both directions, minimal or three-digit padded decimal. Every one of9! a..i positive-digit bijections; independently EACH symbol occurrence may be zero or its assigned positive digit. This dominates every subset of zero-capable letters. No symbol deletion, transposition, arbitrary prime offset or extra encoding. Alphabet26/zero admits all-space degeneracy. Compatibility is not a recovered password.
